newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ralston estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ralston estimate raised.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs analyst Nomi Ghez said Friday she raised her fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for Ralston Purina Co by $0.10 a share to $3.80 per fully diluted share.
-- Ralston earned $3.37 per fully diluted share ($3.56 a share primary) for fiscal 1996 ended September 30 before extraordinary items.
-- Ghez said she also reiterated her buy rating on Ralston Purina, whose products include pet food and batteries, after the company reported stronger than expected fourth quarter earnings.

-- Ralston reported fourth quarter operating earnings of $0.94 per fully diluted share ($1.00 primary), up from $0.68 a year ago ($0.72 primary). Ghez said these results beat her estimate of $0.80 per fully diluted share.

-- Stronger pet food results, in spite of increased ingredient costs, helped propel Ralston's fourth quarter earnings, Ghez said. Other factors included declines in its tax rate, advertising costs and interest expense.
-- Ralston also benefited from earnings of Interstate Bakeries Corp, in which it holds a stake.
